title: North Karelia: 3.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €146,000 a year
markdown:
# North Karelia: 3.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €146,000 a year

> Closes 3.1 of 5.7 missing patients a year (54%) · €146,000 of €1M · €854,000 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in North Karelia, 21 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 6 patients a year. [^care_curative] Against the best quarter of counties, 9.1 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 5.3–12.7). [^care_curative] [^model] Of the about 6 patients a year missing against Finland, the arithmetic puts 1.1 among the operated and 4.6 among those given radiotherapy that aims to cure; the operated share on its own is within the range chance allows. [^care_curative] [^care_surgery] [^model] In the KYS collaborative area, patients do not wait longer: 29.4 days from diagnosis to treatment, against 36.9 in Finland. [^care_time_to_treatment] Fewer are treated to cure. [^care_curative]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 21.4% to 24.4% by 2028: 3.1 more patients a year (range 0.0–4.2), for €146,000 a year, about €47,403 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 54% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (5.7 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €22,400 | 0.8 (0.0–1.6) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 21.4% → 22.2% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €31,600 | 0.3 (0.0–0.3) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 21.4% → 21.7% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 3 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.1 (0.0–1.1) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 13.9% → 14.9% by 2028 |
| 4 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.9 (0.0–1.3) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 21.4% → 22.3% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€146,000** | **3.1 (0.0–4.2)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €504,254 a year; modelled to avoid 0.9 deaths a year (0.2–2.2). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 21.4% (2019–2023, measured) → 24.4% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 13.9% → 14.9% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €854,000 buys nothing more: €146,000 a year already buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure, and those measures are limited by the reachable shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided. [^model] About 81 people die of lung cancer a year in North Karelia; this plan is modelled to avoid 0.5 of those deaths. [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 51 new patients and 44 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 1 of them (0 to 1) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 21.4% to 23.2% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are assumptions, not trial results. Each range runs from all effects at their lowest to all at their highest. It is not a probability. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for the share of residents aged 65 or over, not for stage, illness, histology or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here: 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance in a county-level check. [^model]

flagged.sentence: Against Finland, 1.1 fewer are operated and 4.6 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model]
flagged.reason: The 1.1/4.6 split is arithmetic on the curative shortfall per year, not measured per-treatment gaps; the operated share (13.9% vs 15.0%) is inside the range chance allows, so it cannot be presented as a real shortfall. Rewritten to say this, adding 'a year' and the care_surgery citation.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €854,000 buys nothing more: €146,000 a year already buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure, and those measures are limited by the reachable shortfall, not by money. [^model]
flagged.reason: This is a model result, not an observed fact; added 'In the model'.

flagged.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model]
flagged.reason: The source does not say these would yield more; it only says to look at them to see what else the money could do. Rewritten to match.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents aged 65 or over, not for stage, illness, histology or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted; only the expected share used for comparison is adjusted for the share of residents aged 65 or over. Corrected.

pilot.text_en: A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 51 new patients and 44 decisions reviewed. pilot.text_fi: Kuuden kuukauden pilotti kahdesta toimesta: rintakirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään stereotaktiseen sädehoitoon. Kuudessa kuukaudessa se tarkoittaa noin 51 uutta potilasta ja 44 arvioitua päätöstä. Jos oletuksemme pitävät, noin 1 heistä (0–1) siirtyy sinä aikana parantavaan hoitoon, ja osuus nousee 21,4 %:sta 23,2 %:iin vuoteen 2028 mennessä. Pilotti korvaa oletukset lasketuilla luvuilla.
pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: Kuusi kuukautta on liian lyhyt aika osoittamaan alueen osuuden muutosta. Se riittää laskemaan tehdyt arviot, muuttuneet päätökset ja lähetteet ja vertaamaan niitä samaan jaksoon vuotta aiemmin.
